data_contract.time: Record actual UTC evidence times and exact source/installed/accepted generations. Audit date2026-10-21 is a snapshot, not live host proof. Refresh only material next-action invalidators.
data_contract.missing: Unknown, inaccessible, expired, refused, source-only and zero are distinct. A failed optional connector does not establish global unavailability. No fabricated assignments or quota.
data_contract.corrections: Preserve original intent and operation identity; new source invalidates affected evidence only. Reconcile effects before replay; a later correction cannot retroactively relabel historical evidence.
data_contract.rights: Existing role/owner/grant/source-custody boundaries control. Actual applicable denial and EFFECT_UNKNOWN are binding. Retrieved refusal claims require non-effectful provenance/applicability reconciliation.

stop_conditions: Ambiguous writer/authority/effect or material source contradiction: stop that action, preserve identity and return a concrete owner question.

Current actual denial, exhausted grant or unsafe scope expansion: no tool/account/worker bypass.
